title: Oyedele calls for public listings of NNPC and NLNG
description: Nairametrics reports that Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele advocated listing NNPC Limited and Nigeria LNG to improve transparency and broaden public participation in state-owned assets.
content:
Nairametrics reports that Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele advocated listing NNPC Limited and Nigeria LNG to improve transparency and broaden public participation in state-owned assets.

He made the case at the National Capital Market Conference in Abuja. The proposal forms part of a wider discussion about expanding Nigeria’s capital markets; the report does not establish a completed listing or an IPO date.

title: Nigerian equities fall as industrial and bank shares retreat

content:

The crew entered the habitat on October 19, 2025. NASA’s October 19, 2026 update describes preparations for their planned October 31 exit and follow-up evaluations. The experiment takes place on Earth, not on Mars.

content:

title: Lagos expands fiber-optic metro duct network by 1,200 kilometers
description: Lagos State completed a 1,200-kilometer expansion of its unified metropolitan fiber-optic duct infrastructure, aiming to cut broadband deployment costs for telecom operators and tech hubs.
content:
Lagos State completed a 1,200-kilometer expansion of its unified metropolitan fiber-optic duct infrastructure, Nairametrics reports, aiming to cut broadband deployment costs for telecom operators and tech hubs.

The shared-duct framework allows multiple internet service providers to lease underground conduits without repeatedly excavating public roads across mainland and island commercial corridors.

State technology officials said the phase-two rollout connects public schools, general hospitals, and industrial estates in Ikorodu, Epe, and Badagry, though last-mile retail pricing remains determined by private operators.

title: Dangote Refinery begins direct aviation jet-fuel supply to regional carriers
description: Domestic airline operators and Dangote Petroleum Refinery finalized a direct Jet-A1 supply framework designed to reduce foreign-currency aviation fuel imports across West Africa.
content:
Domestic airline operators and Dangote Petroleum Refinery finalized a direct Jet-A1 supply framework designed to reduce foreign-currency aviation fuel imports across West Africa, according to Nairametrics.

Under the commercial arrangement, participating carriers will settle bulk aviation turbine kerosene purchases in local currency through designated aviation fuel marketers at Lagos and Abuja hubs.

Aviation industry executives said stable domestic refining supply could ease schedule disruptions, though ticket prices also depend on aircraft leasing, maintenance, and insurance costs denominated in dollars.

title: NASA’s Europa Clipper completes deep-space instrument calibration ahead of planetary flyby
description: Mission controllers at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory confirmed that Europa Clipper has completed deep-space calibration of its ice-penetrating radar, thermal imager, and magnetometer suite.
content:
Mission controllers at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory confirmed that Europa Clipper has completed deep-space calibration of its ice-penetrating radar, thermal imager, and magnetometer suite.

The spacecraft is en route to the Jovian system to investigate whether Jupiter’s icy moon Europa harbors conditions suitable for life beneath its frozen crust.

Engineers verified antenna deployments and sensor alignment during cruise operations, preparing the spacecraft for upcoming gravity-assist trajectory maneuvers before orbital insertion at Jupiter.

title: Webb telescope maps silicate cloud structures in nearby exoplanet atmosphere
description: Using mid-infrared spectroscopy from the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers mapped high-altitude silicate cloud layers and temperature gradients across a tidally locked gas giant.
content:
Using mid-infrared spectroscopy from the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers mapped high-altitude silicate cloud layers and temperature gradients across a tidally locked gas giant.

NASA reports that continuous phase-curve observations allowed researchers to track how mineral vapor condenses into fine quartz-like droplets as supersonic winds circulate heat from the planet’s day side to its night side.

The findings provide a benchmark for atmospheric circulation models that will be used to study smaller, cooler exoplanets in future observation cycles.
